subject.title: refactor(chat-ui): render iOS tool calls as flat expandable rows

question: Should the shared Apple chat UI adopt flat expandable tool-activity rows, including tool-only messages without bubble chrome, on this exact PR head?
rationale: The refactor intentionally changes visible iOS and macOS chat interaction rather than repairing a narrowly specified defect, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human landing decision.

options.title: Approve the shared interaction
options.body: Land after an Apple UI owner confirms the exact-head behavior and accepts the compact-row/disclosure design for both iOS and macOS.

options.title: Request a narrower presentation change
options.body: Keep the PR open and specify any required bubble, accessibility, or disclosure adjustments before re-reviewing the shared implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared interaction
recommendation.body: Land after an Apple UI owner confirms the exact-head behavior and accepts the compact-row/disclosure design for both iOS and macOS.
